caption:
Texture is the interior design tip that makes a neutral home look expensive.

When the colour stays quiet the eye reads surface instead. Three textures to one colour is the working ratio: boucle, smoked oak, washed linen.

Start at touching distance. Cushions and throws carry more of the effect than any repaint.

Save this for the next haul.
